notes: All endpoints are served by the RabbitMQ management plugin (default port 15672) and use the same HTTP Basic credentials; paths are relative to that base URL. /api/overview reports cluster-wide aggregates and is labeled only with the responding node ('node'), since it does not break stats down per node itself. /api/queues and /api/nodes return arrays and are exploded into one series per element, carrying identifying labels (queue+vhost+state, or node) but never using high-cardinality or timestamp-like fields as labels. Per-queue and per-node 'message_stats'-derived counters are marked required=false because the management API omits the 'message_stats' object entirely until the relevant activity has occurred on that object. Node 'running' status is modeled as its own boolean gauge (rabbitmq_node_running) rather than as a label, since label values should describe dimensions, not point-in-time state. Node uptime is kept as a gauge despite being monotonic during a node's lifetime, because it resets on restart and does not fit the '_total' cumulative-counter convention.
